svg.text: Cloud monitoring for websites, APIs and critical business processes.
Simulated user journeys · failure detection · incident alerting.
One mark, four grounds. The status point is the only colour in the system and is optional.
Horizontal for navigation, decks and documents. Stacked for badges, covers and profile grids.
One silhouette does all three jobs. Nothing is stacked behind the owl — the shield is the owl.
The icon variant holds at 16px: bolder monitoring ring, larger sensor core, no status point.
ICON VARIANT — favicon · app icon · extension · incident notifications
FULL-DETAIL VARIANT — use from 48px up, or where the mark is large
the status point and the thin guardline are
replaced by the icon variant above.
Outfit SemiBold for the wordmark, Inter for interface and body copy. One accent only.
Delivered as outlines — no font required
Inter Regular / Medium — interface, reports, alerts
MONITORING · DETECTION · INCIDENT ALERTING FOR DIGITAL BUSINESS
